paragraphs.source_en: Whose house is that song from, and this sorrowfully slow zither melody? Under the starry night, between the shadows of pines, I alone pace and listen in silence. The sound waves—the trembling, shaking waves— pierced the cold desolation of the darkened night. In the dim beyond, fresh dew on blades of grass set my inner soul in turmoil. I listened— I listened— I listened and heard the feeling of the zither, the singer’s deepest heart. Let the birds resting on the branches not startle, for our hearts already answer one another. Do not say her heart bears it patiently; she, too, once swallowed her words for your sake. Do not say she is indifferent: in her icy heart is hidden a spark of fervent love. Do you remember her expression at parting, eyes brimming with tenderness and ache? You held her trembling hand— was that the nerve of love itself? Do you remember your mood at the parting? Like ice-water it flooded through your whole body, with a breastful of repression, an ocean of tears, poor soul, so helpless and unfree. Wind in the pine woods—what is it crying out! Disturb not my sympathetic, pouring-out confession. Among seas of people, how many times has a tide of love drowned out the shore of my heart? Over there, the bright autumn moon, already shed its robe of clouds, as if laughing with a voice of joy, "Love is humanity’s vital breath!" O my ardent companion! I envy the honey-sweet ardor of your love, yet tell me—did not twilight and the zither’s song bind our spirits into one communion?

units.source_zh:
是誰家的歌聲，

和悲緩的琴音，

星茫下，松影間，

有我獨步靜聽。

音波，顫震的音波，

穿破昏夜的淒清，

幽冥，草尖的鮮露，

動盪了我的靈府。

units.source_zh:
休道她的芳心忍，

她為你也曾吞聲，

休道她淡漠，冰心裏

記否她臨別的神情，

滿眼的溫柔和酸辛，

你握著她顫動的手——

一把戀愛的神經？

paragraphs.source_zh:
是誰家的歌聲，

和悲緩的琴音，

星茫下，松影間，

有我獨步靜聽。

音波，顫震的音波，

穿破昏夜的淒清，

幽冥，草尖的鮮露，

動盪了我的靈府。

我聽，我聽，我聽出了

琴情，歌者的深心。

枝頭的宿鳥休驚，

我們已心心相印。

休道她的芳心忍，

她為你也曾吞聲，

休道她淡漠，冰心裏

滿蘊著熱戀的火星。

記否她臨別的神情，

滿眼的溫柔和酸辛，

你握著她顫動的手——

一把戀愛的神經？

記否你臨別的心境，

冰流淪徹你全身，

滿腔的抑鬱，一海的淚，

可憐不自由的魂靈？

松林中的風聲喲！

休擾我同情的傾訴；

人海中能有幾次

戀潮淹沒我的心濱？

那邊光明的秋月，

已經脫卸了雲衣，

仿佛喜聲地笑道：

「戀愛是人類的生機！」

我多情的伴侶喲！

我羨你蜜甜的愛焦，

卻不道黃昏和琴音

聯就了你我的神交？
